title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is experiencing a mix of financial maneuvers and technological advancements, with SpaceX's IPO sparking investor interest. Meanwhile, concerns about orbital congestion and defense tech collaborations are shaping future strategies.

themes.title: SpaceX's IPO Sparks Interest
themes.body: SpaceX's shares surged nearly 20% following its historic IPO, making Elon Musk a paper trillionaire. This move has opened the floodgates for potential investments in the space sector, signaling a renewed appetite for aerospace equities.

themes.title: Defense Tech Collaboration Grows
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up on a tactical SDA constellation bid, highlighting the increasing importance of partnerships in defense technology. As budgets swell, collaboration may be the key to navigating the complexities of modern warfare.

themes.title: Orbital Data Center Concerns
themes.body: Astronomers are raising alarms over the potential interference from proposed orbital data centers, which could disrupt critical observations. This tension between commercial interests and scientific integrity is likely to escalate as more players enter the space.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup has allocated an additional $1.4 billion to enhance space resilience, reflecting a growing recognition of the strategic importance of space. As threats evolve, this funding may be crucial in maintaining U.S. dominance in the orbital arena.
